sara_cs: quick flag — Helios compliance requires immutable audit retention for 24 months for their private deployment. default is 90d. renewal in 10 days, need tech plan. :triage:

pranav_eng: we can export to customer-owned S3 with Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) + customer CMK. need bucket name and admin ARN.

helen_helios: we'll create bucket helios-audit-24m and provide admin arn: arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/HeliosAuditAdmin by EOD tomorrow. We want sha256 digests stored too.

li_sre: network ok via interface endpoint. blockers: (1) CMK policy must allow redwood role kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:PutObjectRetention; (2) bucket must be created with ObjectLock enabled and versioning on creation.

pranav_eng: sample minimal role trust we need from customer:
```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-uploader"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```

sara_cs: action items: @pranav_eng update runbook, @helen_helios confirm bucket + admin arn, @li_sre validate exporter can set retention. ops-bot: open ticket?

ops-bot: created RDW-4822: "Helios 24mo immutable audit export" assigned to pranav_eng, li_sre. link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RDW-4822

sara_cs: I'll mark renewal risk as high until bucket + MOU in place. reconvene Friday 9am PT.
